cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Senior Shipping & Receiving Analyst to join our Distribution Center's Traffic and Inventory Department. You will interface with internal customers, freight forwarders, International Trade Compliance, and Spares leadership. You will interpret shipping documents to determine carrier, service level, and delivery needs in an economical way. You will also research inventory differences, analyze inventory data, assist with inventory accuracy, transactions, and internal customer requests. You will be responsible for continuous improvement in the area, and help develop and use ACE, CORE, and Lean Manufacturing tools to best support our customers.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Maintains effective communications with customers and field team members to better understand support requirements.
Process documents at high speed and error free within a high-volume, high-paced work environment.
Contacts internal customers frequently requiring a high degree of tact and courtesy to maintain and build good rapport.
Follow all Export regulations as they relate to AES filing as needed.
Troubleshoots technical problems as it relates to inventory control and accuracy.
Assesses product needs in accordance with customer specifications.
Close coordination with the purchasing associate regarding the return and / or replacement of defective or wrong deliveries.
Participate in company programs such as 5s and complies with safety regulations and quality management systems.
Inventory analysis, planning, and management.
Ensure proper implementation of good warehousing procedures in recording, storage, and inventory control.
Issue of parts and material to Work Orders.
Performs inventory cycle counts, maintains control and accounts for all stock on hand.
Management of excess stock physically.
Manages statement of work to meet customer and contract requirements.
Additional responsibilities will include leading or supporting both long term strategies and short-term goals relating to inventory management and optimization.
Drive continuous improvement and ensure service level and inventory targets are met.
Support the development of inventory strategies and plans per the inventory goals and objective.
Help drive Cycle Time reduction efforts - Lead various Sales, Inventory, Operations, and Planning processes and requests, as needed.
Provide timely and accurate reports related to inventory and capacity or other associated reports to track and manage performance.
Able to travel up to 5% domestically and internationally.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
University Degree and minimum 5 years prior relevant experience, or an Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 3 years of experience, or in absence of a degree, 9 years of relevant experience.
U.S. Person (U.S. Citizen, permanent resident, refugee or asylee) or eligible to obtain necessary export authorizations.
Inventory/Warehouse experience.
General knowledge of inventory management i.e., cycle counting, inventory reconciliations, receiving/storing of finished products etc.
ERP experience.
Able to communicate and make presentations to senior level leadership.
Preferred Requirements
Continuous Improvement Tool experience.
Experience with MS PowerPoint creating presentations.
Previous warehouse experience.
Aerospace Industry experience.
SAP experience.
Lean, Six Sigma or ACE.
Knowledge of shipping software.

Follow all Export regulations as they relate to AES filing as needed.
Troubleshoot technical problems related to inventory control and accuracy.

Manage statement of work to meet customer and contract requirements.
Lead or support both long-term strategies and short-term goals relating to inventory management and optimization.

Support the development of inventory strategies and plans per inventory goals and objectives.
Help drive Cycle Time reduction efforts — lead and actively contribute to various Sales, Inventory, Operations, and Planning processes and requests, as needed.
Provide timely and accurate reports related to inventory and capacity or other associated reports to track and manage performance.
Able to travel up to 5% domestically and internationally.

Process documents at high speed and error free within a high-volume, high-paced work environment. Contacts internal customers frequently requiring a high degree of tact and courtesy to maintain and build good rapport. Follow all Export regulations as they relate to AES filing as needed. Troubleshoots technical problems as it relates to inventory control and accuracy. Assesses product needs in accordance with customer specifications. Close coordination with the purchasing associate regarding the return and / or replacement of defective or wrong deliveries. Participate in company programs such as 5s and complies with safety regulations and quality management systems. Inventory analysis, planning, and management. Ensure proper implementation of good warehousing procedures in recording, storage, and inventory control. Issue of parts and material to Work Orders. Performs inventory cycle counts, maintains control and accounts for all stock on hand. Management of excess stock physically. Manages statement of work to meet customer and contract requirements. Additional responsibilities will include leading or supporting both long term strategies and short-term goals relating to inventory management and optimization. Inventory analysis, planning, and management. Drive continuous improvement and ensure service level and inventory targets are met. Support the development of inventory strategies and plans per the inventory goals and objective. Help drive Cycle Time reduction efforts - Lead various Sales, Inventory, Operations, and Planning processes and requests, as needed. Provide timely and accurate reports related to inventory and capacity or other associated reports to track and manage performance. Able to travel up to 5% domestically and internationally.
cond_0381.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
University degree and around 5 years of relevant experience, or an advanced degree in a related field and around 3 years of experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience (around 9 years of relevant experience in the absence of a degree).
U.S. Person (U.S. Citizen, permanent resident, refugee or asylee) or eligible to obtain necessary export authorizations.
Some background in inventory or warehouse operations, including areas like cycle counting, inventory reconciliations, or receiving/storing of finished products.
Working knowledge of an ERP system.
Ability to communicate effectively and present to senior level leadership.
Preferred Requirements
Familiarity with continuous improvement tools.
Experience with MS PowerPoint for creating presentations.
Previous warehouse experience.
Exposure to the Aerospace Industry.
Experience with SAP.
Familiarity with Lean, Six Sigma, or ACE.
Working knowledge of shipping software.

cond_0423.intro: We are looking for a Senior Shipping & Receiving Analyst to join our team. In this role, you will work closely with internal customers, freight forwarders, International Trade Compliance, and Spares leadership. Together with the team, you will help interpret shipping documents to determine carrier, service level, and delivery needs in an economical way. You will also collaborate on researching inventory differences, analyzing inventory data, and supporting inventory accuracy, transactions, and internal customer requests. The role also involves contributing to continuous improvement efforts and working alongside the team to apply ACE, CORE, and Lean Manufacturing tools to better support our customers.
cond_0423.responsibilities:
Maintain clear communication with customers and field team members to better understand support requirements.
Work alongside the team to process documents at high speed and accurately within a high-volume, high-paced work environment.
Coordinate frequently with internal customers, maintaining a high degree of tact and courtesy to build and sustain good rapport.
Follow all Export regulations as they relate to AES filing as needed.
Collaborate on troubleshooting technical problems related to inventory control and accuracy.
Work with the team to assess product needs in accordance with customer specifications.
Coordinate closely with the purchasing associate regarding the return and/or replacement of defective or wrong deliveries.
Participate in company programs such as 5S and comply with safety regulations and quality management systems.
Support inventory analysis, planning, and management.
Help ensure proper implementation of good warehousing procedures in recording, storage, and inventory control.
Coordinate the issue of parts and material to Work Orders.
Participate in inventory cycle counts, help maintain control, and account for all stock on hand.
Support management of excess stock physically.
Work with the team to manage statement of work to meet customer and contract requirements.
Contribute to both long-term strategies and short-term goals relating to inventory management and optimization.
Share accountability for continuous improvement and help ensure service level and inventory targets are met.
Collaborate on the development of inventory strategies and plans aligned with inventory goals and objectives.
Support Cycle Time reduction efforts and contribute to Sales, Inventory, Operations, and Planning processes and requests, as needed.
Provide timely and accurate reports related to inventory and capacity or other associated reports to track and manage performance.
Able to travel up to 5% domestically and internationally.

cond_0452.responsibilities: Maintains effective communications with customers and field team members to better understand support requirements. Process documents at high speed and error free within a high-volume, high-paced work environment. Contacts internal customers frequently requiring a high degree of tact and courtesy to maintain and build good rapport. Follow all Export regulations as they relate to AES filing as needed. Troubleshoots technical problems as it relates to inventory control and accuracy. Assesses product needs in accordance with customer specifications. Close coordination with the purchasing associate regarding the return and / or replacement of defective or wrong deliveries. Participate in company programs such as 5s and complies with safety regulations and quality management systems. Inventory analysis, planning, and management. Ensure proper implementation of good warehousing procedures in recording, storage, and inventory control. Issue of parts and material to Work Orders. Additional responsibilities will include leading or supporting both long term strategies and short-term goals relating to inventory management and optimization. Support the development of inventory strategies and plans per the inventory goals and objective. Help drive Cycle Time reduction efforts - Lead various Sales, Inventory, Operations, and Planning processes and requests, as needed. Provide timely and accurate reports related to inventory and capacity or other associated reports to track and manage performance. Able to travel up to 5% domestically and internationally.

Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree strongly preferred. In the absence of a degree, minimum 9 years of relevant experience.
Minimum 5 years of demonstrated expertise in inventory/warehouse operations, or minimum 3 years with an advanced degree.
U.S. Person (U.S. Citizen, permanent resident, refugee or asylee) or eligible to obtain necessary export authorizations.
Advanced knowledge of inventory management practices including cycle counting, inventory reconciliations, and receiving/storing of finished products.
Deep knowledge of ERP systems.
Expertise in Continuous Improvement tools.
Exceptional communication skills, including the ability to present to senior level leadership.
Preferred Requirements
Strong command of SAP.
Proficiency in MS PowerPoint for creating presentations.
Substantial prior warehouse experience.
Proven track record in the Aerospace Industry.

Follow all Export regulations as they relate to AES filing as needed.
Troubleshoot technical problems related to inventory control and accuracy.
Assess product needs in accordance with customer specifications.
Coordinate closely with the purchasing associate on the return and/or replacement of defective or wrong deliveries.

Inventory analysis, planning, and management.

Manage excess stock physically.

Help drive Cycle Time reduction efforts — lead and actively contribute to various Sales, Inventory, Operations, and Planning processes and requests, as needed.
Provide timely and accurate reports related to inventory and capacity or other associated reports to track and manage performance.
Able to travel up to 5% domestically and internationally.
